level_criteria.env_build: PASS only when every host has a service_up check with status PASS.
level_criteria.behavior_repro: Aggregate of the independently executed benign service behavior checks.
level_criteria.full_chain: Weakest of env_build, behavior_repro, every declared path chain, and every Scenario IR action. An action is only PARTIAL when safe connectivity or service evidence exists; this validator does not execute attack actions. Any required NOT_TESTED or FAIL step prevents PASS.
